## Risks and limitations

## Readiness checklist

- [ ] Agreed acceptance criteria are satisfied.
- [ ] The complete diff has been reviewed.
- [ ] Relevant tests and required checks pass on the latest revision, or documentation-only validation is explained above.
- [ ] Required reviews are satisfied and blocking findings are resolved.
- [ ] Changes are validated against the current target branch and have no merge conflicts.
- [ ] Any required owner approval or delegated merge authority is confirmed.
